chapter: Sue and Patsy Howard in show business
title: Patsy's club shows in Los Angeles
summary: Patsy mentions Tiny Bradshaw and staging local-talent shows at the Club Alabama and the Apex.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What other bands did you work with? Cause I know you worked in a lot of clubs, right? (Inaudible.)

Yeah, well, I had worked with Tiny Bradshaw, of course. I didn't myself work in the show, I was doing the choreography and producing it, in Chicago, and more or less, I did the shows around here in the clubs which they used more or less local talent. And that's --
Yeah, well, I staged shows at the Club Alabama, and the Apex, when it was -- wasn't that the Apex, Mother, that was on 55th?
